verdicts.reason: I couldn't find a meaningful difference between the two; the only one is a slight shift in the logo's position. They share the same flaws. The four-line headline takes up most of the banner and crowds the top edge. The badges are stacked into a cramped vertical column, and the rotated SUNSET SALE badge jams between LIMITED EDITION and SMALL BATCH, so it reads as a pile rather than a group. The body copy and legal text are too small to read at this size, and a background dot lands on the body copy ('for a taste'). A broken missing-image placeholder sits in the bottom-right corner, and the left column of logo, product and badges is badly crowded.
